name: Produced-water treatment (oil and gas fields)
principle: Standard published produced-water practice: degassing and desanding, multi-stage induced gas flotation for dispersed oil, hydrocyclones or nut-shell filters for tight oil removal, then polishing to reinjection or discharge standards; bridges the WWT sector to upstream operations.

process_steps.name: Induced gas flotation
equipment: IGF cells (3-4 stages) with gas sparging

gaps.item: capital cost per m3/d for a CPI/IGF plus hydrocyclone de-oiling train, with dollar year
gaps.reason: The 2015 Antero figure is recorded but its scope is evaporation/crystallisation ZLD, not de-oiling. No loaded source prices the simpler train as a unit cost; searched 2026-11-16.
gaps.action: Leave open until a source states this exact metric and scope.

costs.metric: capital cost, advanced produced-water treatment complex (MBBR + evaporation/crystallisation)
costs.unit: USD per barrel per day of capacity
costs.basis: Antero Clearwater, WV: USD 275M for 60,000 bbl/d (~28,800 USD per m3/d), treating flowback and produced water to a $4.00/bbl fee. NOTE the scope is an evaporation/crystallisation ZLD complex, not the CPI/IGF plus hydrocyclone de-oiling train this card describes - it is not a de-oiling benchmark.

source.note: Antero Resources, 60,000 bbl/d advanced wastewater treatment complex, Clearwater WV (Aug 2015): USD 275M capex, $4.00/bbl fee, read 2026-11-16
